scope: Existing FULL portable collector acceleration experiment, not the separate narrower battle boundary state recorder. Experimental addon remains unused by active collector/source/native battle paths.
finding: A native codeOnly metadata predicate preserves the compared graphs but is roughly twice as slow as the existing JS predicate. No promotion recommended.

priorWork.experiment: same cached walker using individual descriptor reads
production descriptor walker without experimental per-snapshot prototype-brand memoization

existingCaches: bit-exact finite number encoding; signed zero special and NaNs uncached
function code identity and code tables
current property descriptors and immutable graph-record representations
exploratoryProvenance: Two earlier local trial totals were retained from execution output before timestamped result archiving was added. Original producer hashes for those exploratory invocations were not captured; they are not independently qualified results.

details: mutable function own properties/prototypes/descriptors and constructor accessor
symbol keys, aliases/cycles, sparse arrays, source getter noninvocation
Proxy prototype trap order and exact thrown sentinel identity
observer private-array mutation through a replaced indexOf followed by restoration
inherited descriptor-object value getter and captured descriptor intrinsic behavior

nativeSafety: Official matching Node24.19.0 headers pinned to published SHA256; Node137 ABI and V8 version checked
Public V8 APIs only; no object layout offsets, internal headers or mismatched ABI
No game values, properties, descriptor pointers or hidden-class shapes cached
Per-collector native callback data retains only observer primordials and observer-private array
Unsupported/exotic or modified-intrinsic case permanently returns to original JS predicate
performanceInterpretation: The native experiment still allocates public descriptor/key arrays and crosses V8 APIs repeatedly. The measurement shows this primitive is not a useful acceleration; it does not prove which individual cost dominates.
nextMeaningfulScope: A whole snapshot walker in one native call could remove substantially more interpreter work, but would need a separate identity/weak-root lifecycle, brand/prototype/descriptor/function-code implementation and exact-format differential proof. This is a larger unimplemented task, not a claimed speedup.
limitations: Observer only; no battle mechanics changed
Single ordinary-function-heavy microbenchmark, not representative full-program performance
Native inspector conservatively and permanently falls back after unsupported shapes or intrinsic mutation
Factory must capture original realm intrinsics before untrusted program execution
Shared trace closure/weak-content coverage boundaries remain unchanged
